description: Deterministic note-quality benchmark corpus. Each entry pairs a source transcript with a hand-written reference document (the shape a good model answer should take) and the minimum content-preservation coverage the QA layer must observe between them. Coverage is measured by gamas_bot.qa.run_note_qa; no network, provider or model call is involved.

fixtures.notes: Persian+English clinical lecture: dosages, mg/mL/kg/mmHg, HbA1c, BP pair, eGFR, AKI.
Persian-dominant HCI lecture with English terminology (WIMP, Fitts, Nielsen heuristics).
Persian algorithms lecture: big-O, merge sort, hashing, numeric comparison at n=1000.
Fully Persian humanities lecture. The QA layer must report zero signals instead of inventing gaps.
Heavy code-switching. Spoken code yields phonetic tokens ('equals', 'string') that a good note legitimately rewrites, so term coverage is a threshold rather than 100%.
Presentation slides_outline() text: slide headings, bullets and speaker notes.
